candidates.topic: Mars in Cancer — Emotional Drive vs. Practical Action
candidates.teaser: Mars is in the one sign it least belongs in — and it's quietly reshaping how you take action right now.
candidates.video_title: Mars in Cancer Is Changing How You Fight
candidates.video_description: Mars in Cancer doesn't attack — it retreats, protects, and strikes from emotion. This placement rewires your drive in ways most people never notice. Here's what's actually happening.
candidates.script: Mars in Cancer doesn't want to fight — it wants to feel safe first. Right now, Mars sits at 13° Cancer, and astrologers say this is one of its most misunderstood placements. Instead of charging forward, you might be hesitating, protecting, or acting only when something deeply personal is at stake. That's not weakness — in traditional astrology, that's Mars working through the emotional body. So ask yourself: what are you actually defending?

candidates.topic: Neptune Retrograde in Aries — Dissolving False Identity
candidates.teaser: Neptune just turned retrograde in Aries — and it's about to expose the identity you've been performing.
candidates.video_title: Neptune Retrograde Is Stripping Your Mask Off
candidates.video_description: Neptune retrograde in Aries pulls back the curtain on who you've been pretending to be. With illusions dissolving, raw truth about your sense of self rises to the surface. Are you ready to see it?
candidates.script: Neptune retrograde doesn't bring chaos — it brings clarity you weren't ready for. Right now Neptune is retrograde at 3° Aries, and in astrology this is the planet of illusion moving through the sign of identity and self. Astrologers interpret this as a period when the masks we wear — the personas we perform for others — start to crack. Whatever version of yourself you've been selling to the world, this retrograde asks: is it actually you?

candidates.topic: Waning Gibbous Moon in Taurus — Release and Sensory Reset
candidates.teaser: The Moon in Taurus right now is asking you to let go of something you've been holding onto way too tightly.
candidates.video_title: The Moon in Taurus Is Telling You to Let Go
candidates.video_description: A Waning Gibbous Moon in Taurus is one of astrology's quietest but most powerful release points. It's not about doing more — it's about surrendering what no longer serves your sense of security.
candidates.script: If you've been white-knuckling something you refuse to release, the Moon in Taurus right now is speaking directly to you. In astrology, a Waning Gibbous Moon is the phase of gratitude and surrender — and in Taurus, it hits the body, the finances, and the things we cling to for comfort. The Moon sits at nearly 5° Taurus today, and traditional interpretation says: what you refuse to release is exactly what's keeping you stuck. What is it for you?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 12th House — The Hidden Room of Your Chart
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that holds your deepest secrets — and most people have no idea it's there.
candidates.video_title: The 12th House: The Part of You Nobody Sees
candidates.video_description: The 12th house is the most misunderstood corner of astrology — linked to hidden enemies, self-undoing, and buried gifts. What's lurking in yours could explain patterns you've never been able to name.
candidates.script: Most people know their Sun sign. Very few dare to look at their 12th house — and astrologers say that's exactly where your most unconscious patterns live. In traditional astrology, the 12th house rules hidden enemies, secret fears, and the parts of yourself you've exiled. But here's the twist: it also holds your most profound spiritual gifts. Whatever planet sits in your 12th house has been working on you in the dark. Maybe it's time to turn the light on.

candidates.topic: Jupiter in Leo — Luck, Ego, and the Danger of Too Much Shine
candidates.teaser: Jupiter in Leo is the luckiest placement of the year — but astrologers say it comes with a catch most people ignore.
candidates.video_title: Jupiter in Leo: The Luckiest Trap in Astrology
candidates.video_description: Jupiter expands everything it touches — and right now it's in Leo, the sign of ego, performance, and desire for recognition. The luck is real, but so is the inflation. Know the difference before it costs you.
candidates.script: Jupiter in Leo sounds like a dream — and right now at 13° Leo, astrologers say the expansion is very real. Recognition, creativity, and bold opportunity are all on the table. But Jupiter doesn't just bring blessings — it amplifies everything, including the ego. Traditional astrology warns that Jupiter in Leo can tip from confidence into overreach faster than you notice. So yes, this is your moment to shine. Just make sure you still know who you are when the spotlight moves.
